outcomes.text: When you **Trade Blows** bare-handed and without any armor and/or shield, your body inflicts 1d6 dmg. You also get access to the following maneuvers (in addition to the usual choices on Trade Blows):
bullets: *Elbows & knees* — Increase your damage die by one step
*Head-butt* — On a 10+, you create a fleeting opening for another PC
*Kick* — On a 10+, you can impede any of their movement
*Pow, pow* — Get **adv** to your dmg roll

submoves.title: Signature Weapon
submoves.description: If you're a Fighter, your signature weapon is replaced by your whole body. Change any range, properties, or enchantments that wouldn't make sense, as well as any items or appearance.

outcomes.text: Add the following maneuvers to your **Dirty Fighting**:
bullets: *Grapple* — On a 10+, you can put an opponent your size on the ground and impede their movement. While you maintain this, you can inflict 1d4 dmg to them every time they act
*Haymaker* — You can choose to get **dis** to your **Trade Blows**. If you do, on a 7+, you inflict max dmg
*Hip toss* — On a 10+, you can choose to throw an opponent your size up to **close**
*Knockout* — On a 10+, you can knock a Bloodied foe unconscious

title: Second Wind
description: Once per session, when you **grit your teeth and force yourself through the pain**, restore half your lost HP (rounded down) and clear a Condition.

title: Swift-footed
description: While you wear no armor or shield, you get +dex to your armor.

title: Vanderbal's Improvised Style
description:
You can wield any object that would normally not be considered a weapon as one. When you do, it has the same range, properties, and enhancements as your body, and it inflicts the same dmg.

You also get **adv** to **Defy Danger** using an unorthodox solution.
